commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' 0 - 3 Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
90+1' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90' 2 additional min. will be played.
87' Half-chance! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga reacts well to snuff out the attack.
86' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Thomas Lemar (Girona) is booked for saying more than Jose Guzman was willing to tolerate.
83' Substitution. Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid) in, Alexander Sorloth out.
80' Bryan Gil (Girona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
78' Diego Simeone prepares a substitution. Marcos Llorente is replaced by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Julian Alvarez departs the field of play to be replaced by Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid).
77' Substitution. Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) on for Conor Gallagher.
75' Girona fail to score from a corner as Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid) leaps to collect the ball.
74' The attendance is 12363.
74' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

73' What a wasted opportunity by Alex Moreno (Girona)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Jan Oblak makes an astonishing save to thwart him. Girona force their opponents to concede a corner.
71' Substitution. Viktor Tsygankov walks off the pitch and Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) comes on as a substitute.
71' Michel has decided to make a change. Thomas Lemar (Girona) replaces Ivan Martin.
70' The foul by Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) was seen by Jose Guzman who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
68' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
66' Paulo Gazzaniga displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
64' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
64' A great run by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atl. Madrid.
63' Paulo Gazzaniga is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid). Easy save!
61' Here is a change. Alejandro Frances is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Hugo Rincon (Girona).
61' Here comes a substitution. Arnau Martinez is given a rest as he is replaced by Bryan Gil (Girona).
61' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
60' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) receives a pass then lets rip from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
57' Jose Guzman shows a yellow card to Arnau Martinez (Girona) for a tough tackle.
56' Koke (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
55' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jose Guzman who sees an offensive foul.
54' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
52' The linesman signals that Alex Moreno (Girona) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
51' Alex Moreno (Girona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
49' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.

48' A decent save by Paulo Gazzaniga. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) finds some space near the penalty spot to meet a cross and head it down to the middle of the goal, but the effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
48' Koke (Atl. Madrid) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
46' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
46' Michel makes a switch. Yaser Asprilla (Girona) is coming on in place of Joel Roca at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
45+2' The free kick is delivered by Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
45+1' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid). Girona get a free kick.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Alejandro Frances (Girona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
43' Atl. Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

43' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Atl. Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
42' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) is adjudged offside.
41' Alejandro Frances (Girona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
38' 0 - 2 Goal! Julian Alvarez passes the ball to Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Paulo Gazzaniga couldn't do anything about it. 0:2.
36' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Jose Guzman blows his whistle and signals a foul after Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) brought his opponent down.
34' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
32' The linesman raises his flag. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged offside.
32' The ball is cleared after Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
32' Great teamplay by Atl. Madrid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
28' Diego Simeone is forced to make a change. Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) is unable to continue due to injury, Conor Gallagher comes on.
27' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
26' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
24' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
24' Although Diego Simeone (Atl. Madrid) is just on the bench, Jose Guzman has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.

23' Jan Oblak pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Axel Witsel (Girona) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the right post, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
22' Alex Moreno (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
21' Ivan Martin (Girona) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
20' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
18' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
17' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul and Jose Guzman immediately signals a free kick.
15' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
13' 0 - 1 Koke (Atl. Madrid) blasts the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it flies straight into the top right corner of the net!
11' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
11' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes a short corner kick.
10' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid).

9' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
7' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Koke (Atl. Madrid) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atl. Madrid.
3' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Atl. Madrid win a corner.
1' Marc Pubill (Atl. Madrid) trips an opposition player and Jose Guzman signals a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Atl. Madrid will have the kick-off.
Jose Guzman is the one to supervise the game today.
